table.name: Ignition Cut - Switch Input
table.description: Arms the standalone Ignition Cut V9 limiter at the proven six-channel P1L final-stage charge gate. Launch Control V7 owns a separate request to the same installed cut engine and does not depend on this switch.

table.name: Ignition Cut - RPM Limit
table.description: Spark-cut threshold stored as RPM/32. Example: 6880 RPM = raw 0xD7.

table.name: Ignition Cut - RPM Hysteresis
table.description: Standalone limiter only. Once cutting starts, spark resumes below Cut RPM minus this value. Raw 0xFF preserves the legacy zero-hysteresis behavior and displays as 0 RPM; raw 0x00 also selects zero hysteresis.

table.name: Ignition Cut - Fixed Injector Pulse Width
Pulse Width While Spark Is Cut

table.description: Standalone limiter only. Overrides injector pulse width while its spark-cut request is active. Raw 0xFFFF preserves stock injection and displays as -0.00534 ms; entering -0.00534 writes the stock sentinel. Raw 0x0000 remains a valid zero-pulse setting. Launch ignition mode has its own fixed-IPW setting.

table.name: LC - Switch / Mode
table.description: Arms Launch Control V7. The clutch input arms the latch; speed and throttle release it.

table.name: LC - Cut Type
table.description: Fuel mode uses the native staged limiter with independent soft and hard RPM thresholds. Ignition mode owns a separate request to the installed Ignition Cut V9 engine; the standalone Ignition Cut switch may remain off.

table.name: LC - Clutch Polarity
table.description: Electrical sense of the clutch or toggle input.

table.name: LC - Soft Cut RPM
table.description: Lower launch threshold stored as RPM/32. Fuel mode begins the stock staged injector cut here; ignition mode requests spark cut here. Example: 4000 RPM = raw 0x7D.

table.name: LC - Hard Cut RPM
table.description: Upper fuel-mode threshold stored as RPM/32. It must be at or above Soft Cut RPM; firmware clamps a lower value to the soft threshold. Raw 0xFF is the unconfigured sentinel and safely uses Soft Cut RPM + 96 RPM, saturating instead of wrapping.

table.name: LC - Ignition RPM Hysteresis
table.description: Launch ignition mode only. Once spark cut starts, it resumes below Soft Cut RPM minus this value. Raw 0xFF and 0x00 both select and display as zero hysteresis. Fuel mode ignores this setting.

table.name: LC - Ignition Fixed Injector Pulse Width
Pulse Width During Launch Spark Cut

table.description: Launch ignition mode only. Overrides injector pulse width while the launch spark-cut request is active. Raw 0xFFFF preserves stock injection and displays as -0.00534 ms; entering -0.00534 writes the stock sentinel. Raw 0x0000 remains a valid zero-pulse setting. This value wins if both spark-cut requests are active. Fuel mode ignores it.

table.name: LC - Arm Speed
table.description: Near-standstill arming guard. A clutch press at or above this speed does not arm a cleared latch.

table.name: LC - Max Speed
table.description: Releases the launch latch once vehicle speed reaches this value. Must be greater than Arm Speed.

table.name: LC - Min TPS
table.description: Continuous throttle gate. Dropping below this value immediately clears the launch latch.
